Anyone charges their phones wirelessly exclusively?

Started out with magsafe integration I have been charging my iPhone 13 Pro Max wirelessly for almost a year now. Got a magsafe wireless charger in my car and bedroom. It has gotten to the point when I needed a lightning cable to connect my phone to my pc I could not find one. I will probably won’t care much for the USB-C conversion in 2024 :). 0
